text:
```yaml
name: Publish Package

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'tools/cc-sdd/**'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      id-token: write
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: tools/cc-sdd/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: tools/cc-sdd
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        working-directory: tools/cc-sdd
        run: npm test

      - name: Build package
        working-directory: tools/cc-sdd
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        working-directory: tools/cc-sdd
        run: npm publish --provenance --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update README description
        uses: peter-evans/dockerhub-description@v4
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD }}
          repository: gotalab/cc-sdd
          readme-filepath: tools/cc-sdd/README.md
          short-description: "AI-native development tool for automated software specification and implementation"
          enable-url-completion: true
          image-extensions: ".md,.txt,.json,.yml,.yaml"
```
